notes: The original SQL for the two known canonical production baseline migrations has not been recovered.
Repository migration files and the production ledger are not one-to-one. Candidate mappings are not verified provenance.
Never run production db push, edit supabase_migrations.schema_migrations directly, fabricate baseline SQL, or bulk-repair migration history while this state is unreconciled.
Only a reviewed, reproducible, evidence-backed mapping and an approved production plan may change this state.

The production gate additionally requires every known baseline entry to have an individually verified mapping, a non-empty in-repository evidence artifact, a valid reviewed commit/date, and named approval.
